forks.title: Hosted-turn contract: plugin skill, or the runner's own prompt?

card.problem: Under ADR-100 the runner runs claude -p in the customer's checkout (blueprint-runner.mjs:211-215) with a fixed DEFAULT_PROMPT (line 185) and --allowedTools 'mcp__blueprint Read Glob Grep' (no Skill tool). The customer's Claude need not have bett3r-ai-workflow installed. Should the hosted-turn contract be a plugin skill the runner loads, or the runner's own prompt (closing ESAS-200 into ESAS-205)?
useCases: customer machine without the plugin runs a design job
a local session with the plugin installed must not trigger hosted rules

options.label: Plugin skill blueprint-hosted-turn; runner loads the plugin and allows Skill

walks.given: a runner on a machine without bett3r-ai-workflow
walks.then: the agent runs without the contract unless the runner ships or installs the plugin
walks.text: Given a runner on a machine without bett3r-ai-workflow, when a design job runs, then the agent runs without the contract unless the runner ships or installs the plugin.

options.label: Close ESAS-200 into ESAS-205; the server serves the instructions with each claimed job from a store the platform admin edits at runtime (bundled default on the server); ADR-011 superseded (owner reframe 2026-09-28)

walks.then: the agent follows the headless rules and real refusal codes carried in the runner's own prompt
walks.text: Given a runner on any machine, when a design job runs, then the agent follows the headless rules and real refusal codes carried in the runner's own prompt.

options.label: Plugin is source; runner vendors SKILL.md and passes it via --append-system-prompt

walks.given: a change to the plugin skill
walks.then: it reaches customers only after a plugin bump, a runner re-vendor and a runner release, guarded by a cross-repo drift check
walks.text: Given a change to the plugin skill, when it merges, then it reaches customers only after a plugin bump, a runner re-vendor and a runner release, guarded by a cross-repo drift check.

recommendation.why: The customer-hosted runner cannot assume our workflow plugin, and a prompt the runner already ships is the only copy that reaches a plugin-less machine with zero install steps.

card.ifOverturned: A or C: write the blueprint-hosted-turn skill with the corrected code list (HOST_UNREACHABLE, RUN_GRANT_ENDED, PATHS_NOT_AVAILABLE_HOSTED, CONFLICT_PENDING_SYNC), amend ADR-011, bump plugin.json, and have ESAS-205 add Skill + a plugin load to runAgent.

forks.title: Can a runner decline or pin the server-served instructions, and does it keep a bundled fallback prompt?

card.problem: Under ESAS-200-F1 the server serves the hosted-turn instructions with each claimed job; an admin edit then goes live for every customer's agent. The runner today also carries its own DEFAULT_PROMPT (blueprint-runner.mjs:209).
useCases: A platform admin edits the instructions
A job arrives without instruction text (older server, bug)

options.label: Always served: no runner opt-out and no bundled fallback; a job without instructions fails with a clear error; the instruction version and hash are recorded per job

walks.given: a runner claiming a job whose claim reply lacks instructions
walks.then: it reports the job failed with a named error and starts nothing
walks.text: Given a runner claiming a job whose claim reply lacks instructions, when it would start the agent, then it reports the job failed with a named error and starts nothing.

options.label: Served by default, with a runner flag (--instructions bundled) to use its own copy

walks.when: an admin edits the served text
walks.then: that runner keeps running its bundled copy
walks.text: Given a runner started with --instructions bundled, when an admin edits the served text, then that runner keeps running its bundled copy.

options.rejectedBecause: a choice inside the runner is business logic; the runner is an interface only (owner, 2026-09-29)

options.label: Served, with the runner's bundled prompt as a fallback when none arrives

walks.given: a runner with a bundled DEFAULT_PROMPT
walks.then: it silently runs its own text
walks.text: Given a runner with a bundled DEFAULT_PROMPT, when a claim reply lacks instructions, then it silently runs its own text.

options.rejectedBecause: the runner would decide what the agent is told

recommendation.why: Owner rule 2026-09-29: the server is the brain and the runner holds no business logic; supersedes the 'runner keeps only a fallback' clause of ESAS-200-F1.

card.ifOverturned: Re-add a bundled prompt and a flag in blueprint-runner; the claim contract is unchanged.
